# Guideline-directed medical therapy for HFrEF

For heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (ejection fraction at or below 40 percent),
guideline-directed medical therapy combines four drug classes: an ARNI or ACE inhibitor, a
beta-blocker, a mineralocorticoid receptor antagonist, and an SGLT2 inhibitor. Titrate each to the
target dose as blood pressure and renal function allow. A resting heart rate that stays elevated
despite an adequately dosed beta-blocker may warrant additional rate control.
